Appears: 5 -- wilbraham 1802-04-21 1806-10-10 1815-05-01 1824-07-13 1824-07-15 1 -- wilbraham{,} crown office 1824-07-14
According to Bulletins of State Intelligence and c. 1828 (London) under the heading Crown Office, February 15, 1828 'Members returned to serve in this present parliament: Town and port of Dover William Henry Trant, esq. in the room of Edward Bootle Wilbraham, Esq now Baron Skelmersdale, one of the Peers of the United Kingdom .
In addition, a letter was printed in The Times (31 October 1821, page 2) regarding Wilbraham's letter on the subject of Sir Robert Wilson's dismissal.
